messages:
erin: quick note — onboarding sample hit duplicated webhook sends when auth refresh returned a 429. minimal log below.

pat: paste logs?

erin: 
```
2026-03-24T11:00:00Z app req=opX status=401
2026-03-24T11:00:01Z auth refresh -> 429
2026-03-24T11:00:01Z app retry -> webhook opX
2026-03-24T11:00:02Z app retry -> webhook opX
```

dina: root cause: no jitter on refresh + no idempotency header on outgoing webhook.

erin: proposal: add full jitter for auth refresh (AWS-style) + middleware that injects Idempotency-Key from payload.operation_id if present. opt-out header for tests.

pat: small PR idea: keep retry config backwards compatible by adding jitter: [none,fixed,full] default full for samplekit. also emit metric samplekit.duplicate_detected.

qa-bot: suggested test: run race harness 1000x with auth 429 on first refresh, assert <=1 webhook per operation_id.

erin: I'll open PR for middleware + README blurb. dina you want jitter change?

dina: yup, will do the SDK change and add the metric. will ping when CI green. :white_check_mark:
